Wide panoramic landscape, approximately 1536x1024 or landscape 3:2 composition. NO TEXT, NO UI, NO PEOPLE, NO FISHING EQUIPMENT, NO LOGOS. Soft painterly illustration with refined natural detail, transparent jade and pale turquoise Japanese mountain stream in summer / early autumn, warm dappled sunlight, mossy slate rocks, elegant trees, distant wooded hills, wind-touched grasses, luminous clear shallow water. Readable game camera: river occupies middle horizontal band between y=0.28 and y=0.72, continuous walkable near-bank gravel/earth strip along lower y=0.74 to 0.91. Four recognizable fishing spots arranged horizontally: left clear shallow gravel riffles, mid-left mossy boulder pool, mid-right leafy overhang and quiet deep jade pool, right inflow stream joining main river with gentle foam. These 4 spots must all remain visible in a landscape crop, no dominant foreground tree blocks water. Sky and far forest occupy upper quarter. NO vast mountains dominating scene. Perspective roughly from slightly elevated far side? Ensure NEAR bank is foreground lower frame, far bank background. Plenty unobstructed open river surface for bobber and subtle ripple animation. Very high quality illustrated scenery, calm, cozy but not childish, natural handcrafted brushwork, not flat geometric or pixel art, not photorealism. Painterly coherent palette warm sage, jade, blue slate, muted golden light. Crisp details at game scale, quiet scene, no dramatic spectacle, no manufactured buildings. It must be actual reusable background artwork, not a mock-up game screenshot.

outputs.prompt: Create ORIGINAL production 2D game sprite atlas, transparent background, landscape 1536x1024. EXACTLY eight separated full-body versions of SAME adult fisher in 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS, equal cell grid; every figure entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent spacing and same visual size, feet aligned at bottom of cell. Natural anatomically correct male adult outdoors angler, warm beige bucket hat, sage green long-sleeve overshirt/jacket over cream shirt, warm brown straight trousers, dark ankle hiking boots, quiet appealing face small, premium soft painterly illustrated 2D matching serene jade river scenery. Side 3/4 view, all characters facing RIGHT. Natural human anatomy, exactly 2 arms 2 legs each, recognizable hands no grotesque fingers, comfortable compact silhouette. NO fishing rod, NO fishing line, NO fish, NO scenery, NO labels or numbers, NO UI. Hands mime holding an invisible rod grip roughly at chest/waist; code will attach actual rod later. Top row left to right: 1 standing relaxed idle right hand forward at mid-chest and left hand near waist, 2 walking with left foot forward and arms modestly bent, 3 walking right foot forward, 4 preparing cast with both hands chest-high and torso slightly rotated. Bottom row left to right: 5 release cast with hands extended diagonally right and slight forward lean, 6 hook upward gesture hands rising near shoulder while planted boots, 7 reeling with two hands close together in front of chest, 8 proud quiet landed catch pose empty hands slightly lifted but NO visible fish. Calm natural poses, refined texture and soft shaded fabric, clean transparent alpha edges, not photorealistic, not a stick figure, not chibi. All figures consistent clothing, proportions, light from upper left, moderate detail usable at 100–160px character display. NO duplicated limbs, no missing ankles, no cropped boots.

Exact grid: 2 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS, one fish per cell, all FULL SIDE VIEW and facing RIGHT, generous transparent margins; all six silhouettes fully visible including every tail and fin. No shadows beneath fish, no water or scenery, NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO NUMBERS, NO UI, no people. Premium calm painterly 2D illustration, natural scientifically plausible fish body and elegant subtle brush texture, clean alpha edges, coordinated with jade river and outdoor fisherman illustrated game. Refined highlights on scales, clear species identification, not photorealistic, not exaggerated monster/cartoon. Cells ordered LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM: 1 Oikawa (Japanese pale chub), slender silvery slim body with muted blue/rose iridescence and modest forked tail. 2 Ugui (Japanese dace), elongated olive gray silver body, single muted gold side stripe, subtle orange fin edges. 3 Yamame (landlocked cherry salmon), silver pale golden body with dark blue oval vertical parr marks and scattered black spots, small adipose fin. 4 Amago (red-spotted masu trout), silver pale gold with dark parr marks AND visibly delicate red spots, orange-cream fin edges. 5 Iwana (Japanese char), dark olive-brown upper body with distinct pale cream/yellow small round spots, warm yellow lower body and rounded tail. 6 Nijimasu (rainbow trout), silvery teal upper body, beautiful muted rose lateral stripe and small black speckling especially dorsal/tail. Ensure fish shapes varied but scale consistent, each whole fish centered, attractive and wholesome on small catch cards at 160px width. Natural closed/slightly open mouths, one visible eye each, no grotesque teeth. The final sheet MUST contain exactly six full isolated fish artworks.
